summary: Each state elects its governor on its own schedule, and each governor has their own party, whatever party holds the White House.
realLife: Governors are elected state by state, most for four-year terms, in different years. The election lists show each governor's party, which can be the same as the President's or not.
sources: National Governors Association, Gubernatorial Elections: https://www.nga.org/governors/elections/
